scope: Controllers based or operating in Somalia: processing in Somalia that involves targeting, monitoring online behaviour or offering goods/services to individuals in Somalia (Arts. 4-5)
applies_to: Controllers and processors operating in Somalia; extra duties (DPO, impact assessments) for controllers of major importance
key_requirements: Breach notification within 72 hours; DPO and DPIA for major-importance controllers; cross-border transfers only to adequate countries or with safeguards or consent (arts. 30-31); registration of controllers and processors
data_categories: Personal data and sensitive personal data, plus an undefined 'public data' category overseen by the Authority (Art. 6)
penalties_range: Authority may investigate and impose fines; amounts not stated in the sources read
exemptions: Art. 5: personal/household use; non-major-importance controllers until 23 Mar 2025; crime, public health emergency, national security (5(3)); journalistic, educational, artistic, literary use (5(4))
deceased_data: Not addressed: the Act does not mention deceased persons' data
research_exemption: Archiving in the public interest or historical, statistical or scientific research is a lawful basis for processing (art. 14(2)(k))
genetic_data: Genetic data are not in the sensitive-data list (art. 2(15): biometric, race/clan/ethnic origin, religion, health, marital status/sex life, political opinions; the Authority may add categories)
notes: Signing date reported as 20, 21 or 23 March 2023; Authority launched Feb 2024; Implementation Regulation, Guidance and ADR Procedure issued; Council of Ministers approved a public-data regulatory framework in early 2026; controller registration began May 2026
